summary: Demolition of Michael Garron Hospital’s former A, B, C, and F Wings is complete, clearing the Coxwell Avenue frontage for reconstruction as the campus’s new address point. title: Yonge Line 1 North Extension: Preparing to go Underground
summary: This past week, another major step was taken in the the expansion of Toronto's rapid transit system as excavation of the tunnel launch shaft for the Yonge North Subway Extension was completed. Located just south of Langstaff Road East in Markham's Thornhill area, the shaft will allow for the insertion of tunnel boring machines (TBMs) to excavate over 6 kilometres of twin tunnels, eventually linking up with Line 1's longstanding northern terminus at Finch station in Toronto.
